DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis

The combination of intense itching, red bumps, recent travel to Miami (a region with sandfly populations), and your history of diabetes (which increases susceptibility) strongly suggests this diagnosis. I have requested a Leishmanin skin test and close-up images of the lesions to confirm the presence of the parasite.
